title: Is Royal Bank Of Canada (TSX:RY) Fully Priced After A 168% Run?
summary: Royal Bank of Canada has delivered a powerful multiyear run, and the stock now sits at a level where every dollar of investor capital is being asked to trust how efficiently the bank can keep compounding its own.
